# Dynasty Tree Builder

> A free, browser-based family tree maker for Dungeons & Dragons and other
> tabletop RPG campaigns. Users map noble houses, NPC relationships, bloodlines
> and rivalries on a drag-and-drop canvas, then share a read-only link with
> players or export the tree as a PNG. No account is required.

Dynasty Tree Builder is not genealogy software. It is built for fictional
families, where parents are often unknown, heirs are secretly bastards, and
houses marry for treaties that later collapse. Characters carry a role (Head of
House, Heir, Consort, Rival, Mage, Rogue and others) and narrative flags
(founder, bastard, adopted, exile, deceased), so a tree works as a campaign NPC
relationship map rather than a chart of descent.

It runs entirely in the browser. Guest mode opens directly onto the canvas and
saves to the browser's local storage; signing in is optional and only exists so
dynasties follow the user between devices. Building, sharing and exporting are
free, with no trial period and no payment details.

Audience: dungeon masters, worldbuilders, players writing a character backstory,
and writers or play-by-post groups. Nothing is tied to a ruleset, so it suits
D&D, Pathfinder, homebrew systems, or non-game fiction.

Publisher: Bag Of Holding Tools — free tools for tabletop games.

## Pages

- [Home](https://dynastytreebuilder.vercel.app/): What the tool does, features, use cases and FAQ.
- [Canvas](https://dynastytreebuilder.vercel.app/tree): The builder itself, open in guest mode with no signup.
- [Source code](https://github.com/Marksu-u/DynastyTreeBuilder): Public GitHub repository.

## Key capabilities

- Drag-and-drop infinite canvas with automatic generation banding and sibling packing
- Parent/child, partner and adopted relationships, each with its own edge style
- Multiple partners per character, each with a separate offspring line
- Placeholder nodes for unknown parents, so incomplete bloodlines still render
- Per-relationship plot hooks describing why a connection matters at the table
- Custom roles for signed-in users
- Read-only public share links, revocable at any time by unpublishing
- High-resolution PNG export, cropped to the characters, from the editor or a shared view

## Notes

- Legal, privacy, terms and cookie pages are available in French and English at /legal, /privacy, /terms and /cookies.
- Shared dynasty pages (/share/...) are user content and are served with noindex.
